is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 3, 5, 6).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (referred to as L1014F-kdr) and GSTe2 L119F (referred to as I114T-GSTe2) (page 6, 8, 14).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 and Table 2 provide genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for alive and dead mosquitoes (page 14).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in Cameroon, DRC, Ghana, and Uganda (page 3, 5).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study involving field collections and laboratory bioassays/genotyping.

sub_country_location.evidence: Specific locations are provided: Njombe-Penja, Nkolondom, Mangoum (Cameroon), Ndjili-Brasserie (DRC), Obuasi (Ghana), and Mayuge (Uganda) (page 3, 5).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted from May to July 2021 (page 3, 5).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new field collections from 2021.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype data is provided in the main text tables (Table 1 and Table 2).

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the susceptibility of Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations from four African countries to neonicotinoids using different solvents. It also investigated the association between pyrethroid resistance markers (L1014F-kdr and I114T-GSTe2) and survival after clothianidin exposure, finding a negative association for kdr and a positive association for GSTe2.
